reviews.author: Connor Cohen
reviews.text: Tore up brand new rims and didn’t want to take accountability for it. Took a BRAND NEW set of konigs over for a mount and balance. Supplied everything for the install, valve stems, wheels weights, rims and tires. Had the rims returned covered in grease and soap from the install. I briefly checked them over when I put them in the back of my vehicle but it was very difficult given how dirty the rims now were. When I got back to my shop and started cleaning the wheels, I noticed damage on every single wheel, particularly on the inner barrels and on the lips, alongside multiple nicks and scratches. Called up and the lady on the phone was very rude, telling me they weren’t going to fix them and how it’s my fault because I only opened two of the boxes. If that’s the case then two of these rims should be in perfect shape. To top it all off, these are directional tires and all four tires were put on the same way, meaning two of my wheels are mounted backwards thanks to their idiot tech. Went and spoke with the owner today for him to yell at me telling me the same thing how they weren’t going to replace or fix my wheels and I am SOL. Thankfully got my money back for the service but I will never do business with sunrise auto again and I strongly advise against anybody doing business with people who can’t own up to their mistakes.

reviews.author: James Rand
reviews.text: We had a flat tire while driving across North Carolina. Luckily, we had stopped for lunch about 1/4 mile from Sunrise Tire. Shannon came and put air in the tire then followed us back to the shop. In ten minutes he pulled out a screw, put in a plug and had us on our way again. Very nice guy and great service.

reviews.author: Ana Carroll
reviews.text: I am very impressed with the friendliness of the staff and how quickly they are able to work! I highly recommend you come here. Thank you so much for always giving great service.

reviews.author: Rocky Road
reviews.text: I’ve brought them several vehicles and they have always done me right. There have been several instances where they have been significantly cheaper than other places. There’s been a few times where they quoted me a price on the phone and when they saw my vehicle in person it turned out to be cheaper. They could have never told me and I’d have never known the difference. So very honest. And they do good work too.

reviews.author: Emily Wing
reviews.text: Cannot say enough good about these guys! I was traveling over a holiday weekend when I started having car troubles. This amazing team got my vehicle in right away, fixed it quickly, and reasonably, and had me back on the road in an hour. Definitely saved my visit to my daughter and I am immensely grateful for their helpfulness and integrity.

reviews.author: Bridget “Bree” Daniels
reviews.text: They ALWAYS do such good work. I bring all of my vehicles to them fior inspection, work, tires, tuneups or whatever is needed. Joanna is their onsite notary and is the sweetest most cool chick ever. I highly recommend these folks!

reviews.author: Chad Willard
reviews.text: Took my truck up to sunrise had a small vibration coming from the rear They took care of me and got it fixed. Thank you Will definitely be using sunrise tire and automotive in the future.

reviews.author: Mike O'Byrne
reviews.text: We broke down trying to exit I-40. Russ towed us the short distance to his shop. Russ and his mechanic, Shannon, got us back on the road in under an hour. Great people and very fair price. We can't be more pleased.

reviews.author: Yvette Childress
reviews.text: do not go to these people for anything related to your vehicle, i bought 4 tires about 6 weeks ago, ended up having to have my car towed while in Raleigh over the weekend, found out the back 2 tires were shredded? and control arm broken, and the care never had an alignment when the 4 tires were put on, i brought back videos showing the shape of the back tires, and the receipt of replacing the 2 back tires, and the alignment and the broken control arm, (688.00), the owner said he did not put my car on a lift and stated that it just looked like i needed new tires, and that all of this happened after i drove off his lot and for all he knows the control arm wasn't broken when i brought my car to him? how would he have known unless he put my car on a lift! i asked that i be refunded for cost of the 2 back tires only to be told that no he would not do that and that out of all of his customers i was the only complaint that he has had? although i have seen other complaints from other customers, he seemed very uninterested at how bad this could have turned out had my back tire come off!

reviews.author: Brianna Yandell
reviews.text: They tried to get me to pay 400 dollars for changing out my spark plugs and wires and caused a 1500 break in my steering column because they hand tightened my alignment so bad that something popped. I guess they took me for a fool being a single mother there with my child. I wouldn’t let them touch another car of mine if my life depended on it.

reviews.author: Sandra Norman
reviews.text: The owner is super Friendly and extremely nice. I love to have service with such cheerfulness. They did Fast and friendly service and I really will be back including telling all my friends to come here. The name is very apt ,much was like a sunrise. Such fast And friendly service is a little rare nowadays.

reviews.author: bogerssupersport
reviews.text: Russ and Jeremy will make sure you're taken care of. Fair prices and great service! Great place for tires and any other type of automotive repair or upgrades. They did a great job on my Hyundai genesis 5.0 Rspec in the pic below!

reviews.author: Gen X review
reviews.text: I took my car in for a timing belt. 100k time to change it. Four days after the promised completion date they had it running and turned it over to me knocking, engine not idling smoothly, and thought they were done. Four more days later they finally solve the problem..Well they fixed it and 20k miles later, the timing belt breaks. New mechanic is fixing engine which is 3 or 4 thousand worth of repair at this point. Ask new mechanic what is taking so long....he tells me whoever did the work stripped out more than half the bolt holes. They had to install 4 heli coils just to get it to stay together. I would advise working on your own car witb no experience before letting these "mechanics" touch your car!! To top it all off, my dash cam caught him talking to someone about what sounded like a drug deal. Do not trust !!!

reviews.author: Miyah McDonald
reviews.text: The service was above and beyond. The managers were very helpful. Everyone was super kind, definitely would recommend if you need work done on your vehicle!!

reviews.author: Dennis Gill
reviews.text: Stopped here as a 4th try at getting a tire for my car in an "emergency". They hooked me up with a brand new tire, and even mounted it. For under their own out of pocket cost if I had to guess. Very much appreciated y'all. Now I can make it home! The Dog appreciated you letting him chill in the lobby as well lol.

reviews.author: Tiffany Stiles
reviews.text: Used them off & on for 20+ years want return nor anyone else ik. RIDICULOUS pricing on repairs & tows. Don't inform you & owner has NO CLUE what's being or been done to your vehicle & will avoid you if you have questions or issues.

reviews.author: Scott Kinsey
reviews.text: You can bring Sunrise a model T to a 45 foot RV and Russ will give it back to you running like new. One of the few business owners that oversees work performed and takes the time to get the job done correctly. If you want it done right, bring it here!

reviews.author: Brian Wilson
reviews.text: Great service they took great care of my car and when they Problem they fixed wasn't the issue they scanned it again and offered to try replacing the part again just to make sure it wasn't bad no cost to me..haven't fixed the issue yet but it's not from a lack of trying

reviews.author: Liam Baldwin
reviews.text: Was in town to get a used car on black friday and they were one of the only places who were able to give me a pre purchase inspection. Amazing service, very quick and efficient, would recommend to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: LeeShay
reviews.text: Very Good!!! Helped me when others wouldn't and did inspection all in one. Great timing considering the time my car got there.. Will recommend!!! Thank You!

reviews.author: Emily Stuart
reviews.text: Stopped here randomly when our engine light went off and they graciously checked our car with their OPD reader for free right before close. Super appreciative of their help.

reviews.author: Marie Walton
reviews.text: I reserved a Uhaul trailer here. I was running late and started calling 20 minutes before they closed. No answer. I tried calling all the way to the shop no answer. I arrived a few minutes before they closed, open signs all flashing, but doors locked and no answer on the phone. Fenced in lot appears to be open. Several vehicles around, but apparently they closed up shop. No Uhaul today and I'll never attempt to use their services again.

reviews.author: Eugene Foster
reviews.text: Friendly and easy to deal with 07/11/22...they have been at their new location awhile now and are busier. Still great to deal with and seembto be always reasonably priced.

reviews.author: lucille bledsoe
reviews.text: Had my new headlights adjusted the wait time was short.Staff very friendly, I will be going back to them.

reviews.author: Chrisma Stone
reviews.text: They originally told me it would only cost me 100 something dollars then I asked them to do an oil change and a tune up for me then they priced me at 300 dollars but then they call me back and tell me it’s going to now be 500 something dollars. That is absolutely ridiculous and I defiantly will not be going back there ever again. I am beyond mad.

reviews.author: Derrick Jones
reviews.text: People there is very Nice and the service is Great and the Shop is Clean I've already Recommend my friends and Family Members to go there .

reviews.author: johnm tomel
reviews.text: Russ goes out of his way everyday to make sure our Equipment is in top shape! Thanks for all you do! JT

reviews.author: Mark Blevins
reviews.text: I was making a delivery in mocksville and my brake lines burst....these. Guys fixed them quickly with a resonable price...thanks guys
